# GitHub Copilot Pull Request Description Instructions

## Pull Request Guidelines

- Summarize the purpose and scope of the changes.
- List affected articles or files (e.g., KB articles, markdown docs).
- Highlight improvements in accuracy, completeness, readability, and formatting.
- Note any added references, troubleshooting steps, or best practices.
- Specify if markdown lint errors were fixed.

## Example PR Description

"This PR updates KB0011633 to improve diagnostic logging guidance for Active Directory. Changes include:

- Enhanced technical accuracy and completeness
- Added PowerShell script examples
- Updated references to Microsoft documentation
- Fixed markdown lint errors and improved formatting
- Expanded troubleshooting and best practices sections"
